рукожоп.definition:
Or "жопорук", rarely.

[Literally], "the man, which hands growing from his ass".
A person, who can't do anything in right way, or destroy [something]. Analog in [English] - all thumbs.
рукожоп.example:
Он разбил все тарелки. ОПЯТЬ! Вот рукожоп!

He broke all the [plates]. AGAIN! [What a] [all thumbs]!
